subject: Intro: Alia Khan — referral (fast-track scheduling)
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@brightbridge.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: Alia Khan – strong infra/referral (resume attached)

Hi David —

Wanted to introduce Alia Khan, an ex-colleague and a personal referral who I think would be an excellent fit for your Systems/Infra role (particularly around deployment/runtime reliability). She led infra reliability at her last company and has hands-on experience with GPU orchestration and inference runtimes.

Quick notes:
- Top strengths: service reliability, cost-conscious infra optimizations, on-call leadership
- Reason to refer: we had to downsize at BrightBridge and she’s looking for an impact-first role — available immediately

I attached her resume. If you can fast-track a screen this week that would be great — CCing Monica and Priya to coordinate. Alia is flexible mornings PT but prefers no interviews after 3pm PT on weekdays.

Thanks — Sanjay

Attachment: Alia_Khan_Resume_2027.pdf
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@brightbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Alia Khan – strong infra/referral (resume attached)

Thanks Sanjay — and thanks Monica/Priya for jumping on this.

Monica — can you take ownership of scheduling and fast-track her into an initial 45-minute technical screen with our infra hiring panel? Priya, please flag any hiring band/comp constraints if we need an expedited approval.

Tentative interview plan (we can reduce to 45'):
- Initial technical screen (45 min) — infra engineer + hiring manager
- follow-up system design / runtime deep-dive if positive

Candidate availability note from Sanjay: mornings PT, no interviews after 3pm PT. Please propose 3 slots. I’ve attached a simple slots spreadsheet for availability capture.

One ask on the panel: prioritize a question or two about model-serving operational tradeoffs (caching, batching, fallback policies) — that’s key for the role.

David

Attachment: interview_slots.xlsx
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alia Khan <alia.khan@gmail.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@brightbridge.ai>, Kelly Chen <kelly@talentgrid.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Alia Khan — scheduling options

Hi Alia — great to e-meet you, and thanks Sanjay for the intro. I’m Monica on the recruiting team; I’ll set up the screen.

Alia, can you please confirm one of the following 45-minute windows (all PT):
- Thu Dec 2 — 9:30am–10:15am
- Thu Dec 2 — 11:00am–11:45am
- Fri Dec 3 — 8:30am–9:15am

If none of those work, share 3 other mornings you’re available. We’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm and include a short pre-screen rubric for the interviewer.

Also attaching the slots file for quick edits; please upload preferred times if easier.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: interview_slots.xlsx
From: Alia Khan <alia.khan@gmail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@brightbridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 07:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Alia Khan — scheduling options

Hi Monica / David —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I can do Thu Dec 2 at 11:00am PT — that works best for me. I’ve attached an updated resume (small formatting change). Looking forward to the conversation and happy to do a short take-home follow-up if helpful.

A very brief background: I led rollout of a multi-tenant model-serving layer at my last company, focused on latency SLAs and efficient batching. Happy to share specifics during the interview.

Cheers,
Alia Khan
alia.khan@gmail.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachment: Alia_Khan_Resume_2027_v2.pdf
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Next steps / ownership handoff — Alia Khan (interview on Dec 2 at 11:00am PT)

Evelyn — I’m handing the interview ownership to you for this candidate. Interview is scheduled Thu Dec 2, 11:00am PT (45 min). Monica will send the calendar invite with attendees.

Notes for you:
- Focus areas: runtime & deployment tradeoffs (3–5 minutes), service reliability incidents and mitigation (5–7 minutes), and caching/batching design (10–15 minutes).
- Please use the linked debrief rubric after the call and indicate green/yellow/red on production-readiness and system design. Drive link to rubric: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-example-eval-rubric
- If candidate is strong on infra + product sense, suggest fast-tracking to a 2nd system design panel; I’ll expedite approvals.

CCing Monica and Priya so they have visibility. Monica — please confirm invite attendees and include the panel doc in the calendar event.

Thanks — David
